{{Quotation|game|This small village at the northeastern tip of [[Istan]] has a dual purpose. Located near [[Churrhir Fields]], the training grounds for [[Order of the Sunspears|Sunspear]] recruits, Chahbek's docks make an excellent meeting place for new [[Order of the Sunspears|Sunspear]]s. Also, the bluffs around the village provide a good vantage point to watch for [[corsair]] raids head for the islands. As a result, Chahbek is often the first community targeted by such attacks.}}

[[Chahbek Village (outpost)|Chahbek Village]] is the first [[outpost]] that new [[Nightfall]] characters will unlock. It is also the location for the first [[mission]] that they will participate in. It is a small location with only 2 [[henchmen]] and a handful of [[NPC]]s; no other [[NPC service|services]] such as [[storage]] and [[merchant]]s are available, although players can access [[Embark Beach]] or the [[guild hall]] (if in a [[guild]]) for those services.

== Getting there ==
Nightfall characters arrive here upon completion of the tutorial portion in the [[Island of Shehkah]], either completing [[Rally the Recruits (Tutorial)]] followed by [[Into Chahbek Village]] or by completing [[Take the Shortcut (Skip Tutorial)]].

Characters from other campaigns will have to head into [[Churrhir Fields]] from [[Kamadan]] and travel to the southeast corner to talk to [[Historian Laharo]] to gain entry.

== Exits ==
There are no exit portals. Once you arrive in the village from the [[Island of Shehkah]] (for new Nightfall characters), it is ''not'' possible to go back. Although the [[Churrhir Fields]] training area is just outside the village, to access it from Chahbek Village requires completion of the [[Chahbek Village|mission]].
